answer_1.quote: We evaluate using standard AI writing metrics, rather than success‑based task‑oriented metrics ... Our approach, NIFTY, uses implicit negative feedback from the rejected suggestions to improve the AI writer's prediction.

answer_2.quote: We employ both automatic and human evaluation. ROUGE‑L, which has been used previously in AI writing tasks, measures the longest common subsequence within the prediction ... we complement this metric with R@1, which measures the proportion of generated responses that contain the correct intent.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk. As the purpose of the system is to reduce uncertainty about the user's intended reply, we apply a pairwise setup, in which the evaluator is asked to select which candidate reply is most similar to the target reply.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators are shown a target reply and two candidate replies and must select which candidate is most similar to the target.
